payload.name: Endowment Effect
payload.fact: The endowment effect is the tendency for individuals to value an object more highly once they own it compared to when they do not.
payload.boundary: The effect is observed in market settings and is characterized by a discrepancy between willingness-to-accept (WTA) and willingness-to-pay (WTP).

provenance.title: Experimental Tests of the Endowment Effect and the Coase Theorem
provenance.quote_or_locus: This paper reports several experiments that demonstrate that this "endowment effect" persists even in market settings with opportunities to learn
